suite: G8 bounded static wheel catalog map
method: Data-only lexical/source-shape fixtures. Production JavaScript is never executed by this helper or suite.

results.name: Current production is 54 scoped wheel candidates and 37 unique asset paths
Resolved template metadata identifies exact source offsets without claiming unrelated templates
Standalone literal tables produce exact synthetic targets and preserve distinct family paths
Whitespace, comments, quote styles, Unicode titles, escapes and literal trailing commas are supported
Each altered builder remains unresolved and emits no aliases from that builder
Altered mode, chain, mapped arguments and extra catalog operations fail closed
Unsupported literal table wrappers remain explicit and cannot borrow unrelated tables
Computed rows and computed metadata remain unresolved and never execute expressions
Unsafe, escaped, encoded and malformed IDs are blocking errors with no successful partial aliases
Unsafe literal classic paths are rejected before mapping
Duplicate rows and IDs shared across builders are blocking errors
Malformed woven values and titles are blocking errors
Unrelated calls, tables, regexes, strings, comments and shadowed bindings add no aliases
Missing, duplicate and shadow-only builders stay unresolved
Application statements and malicious strings are never evaluated or imported
Limits and invalid source shapes fail closed without executing source
Repeated extraction is byte-for-byte deterministic and preserves the supplied source
